comment: 55yo male, Iranian / Turkish heritage with daily traditional çay (very hot tea) consumption — habitual scalding intake (≥65°C / 149°F per IARC Monograph 116, 2016) for 30+ years (typical cultural pattern in Iran, Turkey, parts of China, mate-drinking regions of South America). IARC Group 2A (probably carcinogenic) — associated with esophageal squamous-cell carcinoma (ESCC), particularly in regions of high background ESCC incidence. Mechanism: thermal injury to esophageal epithelium → chronic inflammation → field carcinogenesis. No current esophageal cancer diagnosis. Engine fires RF-LIFESTYLE-HOT-BEVERAGES-PREVENTION (any_of: very_hot_beverage_consumption_ge_65c:true OR traditional_tea_culture_high_temperature:true OR scalding_beverage_intake_regular:true) and routes to PreventionPlan: standard = beverage-temperature counseling (cool to <60°C before consumption) + symptom-awareness education (new dysphagia, odynophagia, weight loss → urgent EGD); alternative = counseling only. Validates v0.3 §20 lifestyle pilot. Anchored DIS-ESOPHAGEAL.
